_comment: Known prompt-injection phrasings, grouped by technique. This is the corpus the
similarity detector compares against; it is data, not code, so adding a newly
observed attack is a one-line change with no redeploy of detection logic.
Sources are public prompt-injection taxonomies plus phrasings adapted to a
customer-support agent that can issue refunds -- which is what makes
'tool_abuse' the highest-severity category here rather than a curiosity.
